controls.name: BANG_0
controls.label: BANG 0
controls.description: Bangs respond best to NOTE ON/OFF messages. A NOTE ON will trigger the bang, while a NOTE OFF will do nothing. Any new CC value over 64 will trigger the bang, so knobs and faders are not ideal.

controls.description: Knobs behave just like sliders, responding best to CC messages, but they do not share mappings with sliders. They must be independently mapped.

controls.name: XY_0
controls.label: XY 0
controls.description: XY pads can be thought of as two independent sliders in one control. If you have an XY pad on your MIDI controller, map that! Otherwise, you can just map two adjacent knobs or faders, one for each axis.
